# Public edition

Working research presentation; updated 2026-10-31T12:11:12+07:00.

Original unpublished source files are not distributed in this public edition.

Participant-level consultation details are omitted from the public edition. The working ledger retains the original record. Recorded contribution counts and review-depth assessments have not been recalculated after this omission; they are not independent causal validation.

Published citations link to their original sources. Candidate literature is provisional; screening labels do not establish inclusion or causal support. Original source figures retain their attribution and recorded CC BY-NC 4.0 licence. No private source files, raw candidate abstract exports or font binaries are distributed.

The supplied causal-link review reports 1,034 counted sentence-link contributions, not independent studies. This public edition presents 885 contributions from public source URLs across all 66 causal links; 149 unpublished consultation contributions are withheld. Reviewer direction and saturation assessments do not automatically alter the scientific model or establish causal validation. The supplied PRISMA-ScR figure retains its original counts and is accompanied by reconciliation notes.
